description: Every Gmail API surface plus the things Gmail itself will not give you: scheduled sends, sender analytics, follow-up tracking, and an offline full-text mailbox.

novel_features.name: Scheduled send queue
novel_features.description: Write an email now and have it sent at any future time, even though the Gmail API itself has no schedule-send. Delivery requires `schedule run` from cron/launchd (or `schedule run --watch`).

novel_features.name: Sender leaderboard
novel_features.description: See who actually fills your mailbox: per-sender message count, unread count, total size, and first/last seen.

novel_features.name: Storage hogs
novel_features.description: Rank senders and years by mailbox bytes consumed, with the exact cleanup command printed next to each group.

novel_features.name: Follow-up tracker
novel_features.description: List threads where the last word was theirs (you owe a reply) or yours (they never replied), aged past N days.

novel_features.name: Unsubscribe audit
novel_features.description: Rank mailing lists by volume and unread ratio, and emit each list's unsubscribe target ready to act on.

novel_features.name: Filters as code
novel_features.description: Keep Gmail filters in a version-controlled YAML file; diff against live settings and apply the reconciliation plan.
